<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 141.1154 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral exact mass of ~140.1081 Da. The formula that matches this mass within sub‑ppm accuracy is C₈H₁₄ON (C8H14O1N).</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14ON</final_answer>
